367)༄༅/phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi sgrub chen las 'grigs padma'i dgongs rgyan bzhugs so/ /368)༄༅/bla ma dang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal

tei:div.tei:p: 367) ༄༅/ phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi sgrub chen las 'grigs padma'i dgongs rgyan bzhugs so// 368)༄༅/

bla ma dang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'di'i sgo nas sgrub chen tshom bu tshogs sgrub bya ba la/ sna sel rigs sngon du song nas/ cha gsum btang*/ pra khrid las/ sa slong*/ swa bhā wa= sogs/ gdengs bar bsgom bar/ kī la ya= brgya rtsa bzla/ sngags drug phyag drug gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su// gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ sgrub khog las/ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐/ sogs/ gzhal yas khang du gyur/ bar 'dir sgrub rkyang la sta gon mi dgos mod/ smin slob lag brgyun ltar bya na bum sta/ las byang gi bgegs bskrad/ dbang chog nas sngags kyi blug bskyed chog yang a zin ltar/ gtso bum las bum bcas/ lha tshom 'jigs med rang grol ltar/ yang gsang gi pho brang e yi= sogs/ 'gro lugs a zin ltar/ phyag 'tshal bstaud/ bar/ bsnyen pa kha gso btang lugs ya zin ltar/ lhag chog rjes su bdag 'jug blang*/ slob ma lha gon a zin ltar bya ba'am/ 'jug bde ba'i dbang du btang na/ khrus dang bgegs gtor btang*/ sgrub khog nas/ hūm̐: nyon cig= sogs/ phaṭaḥ bar/ las byang gi bsrung 'khaur dang po bton/ hrīḥsngon= yan lag bdun pa/ chags med rin po che'i gtor dbang lo rgyus/ maṇḍal so bdun ma phul/ dbang chog la gsol 'debs/ hūm̐: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor= sogs/ khyod kyis 'grub: bar/ rgyud dag cing snod rung dgos pas skyabs sems rjes bzlos/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs= sogs lan gsum/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi rten sdom pa gsum gyi dam tshig rnams bsrung snyam pas rjes bzlos/ 369)ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dpag med dang*// sdom pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho bzung ba ltar// deng nas bdag kyang lam chen der zhugs te// 'gro la phan phyir de dag bzung bar bgyi/ lan gsum/ so shing sbyin cing 'dor bcug dbang chog gi hūm̐: ye shes rdo rje= sogs nas/

bzang po gyur= bar/ ku sha chung ba sngas dang che ba stan gyi don du zungs la nang par rmi lam mtshan ma brtags par bya dgos pa lags ces brjod/ gtor dbang las/ da lha dang bla ma= sogs mtha' bar ro/ bkra shis brjod/ mchod bstod/ a zin ltar/ skad cig gis sta gon gyi= sogs/ bzhugs par bsam/ bar/ chad brtan mjug bsdu sogs spyi ltar/ rgyal tho 'dzug pa a zin nang ltar bkra shis re re brjod/ dam sri mnan pa la/ gnam chos dkar gtor ram rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud gang rung btang*/ a zin ltar/ rang nyid dbang chen du gsal/ e raṃ dzwa la raṃ/ grub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dam sri pho mo rid cing nyam thag pa'i lus can du bsam/ rdor bzang 'gugs par 'dzud/ sgrub pa zab mo= sbyar ba lan gsum/ bka' brgyad bka' srung nam srod ma bskul/ phur thun tshams bskul/ badzra pa ṇi= lan gsum/ sgrub khog las/ hūm̐: gcig ni brjod med= sogs/ rdul du brlog: bkra shis/ sgo byang phyi nang gnyis a zin ltar/ ༈ ma traṃ bsgral ba ni/ stong thun bshad/ a zin/ rang nyid dbang chen= sogs= ghanḍe hoḥ bar/ sgrub khog gi las kyi slob dpon= sogs/ 370)dur khrod brgyad du bskyed do/ bkra shis/ phur gdab ni/ swā bha wa= sogs/ bsrung bar bsgom/ ye dhar/ 'di mtshams thig tshon/ ras bris la dor/ rgyan 'god ni/ sgrub khog gi/ hūm̐: gu gul= sogs/ de kho na nyid do/ mchod g.yog gis phur sgrom sogs thogs te dkyil 'khor la bskor/ hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu= sogs/ tiṣṭha lhan: a zin/ hūm̐: steng phyogs hūm̐ dkar= sogs/ lhan: bar sgrub khog gi/ hūm̐: sku gsung thugs las= sogs/ yongs rdzogs bkod= bar/ stong thun bshad nas/ sgrub khog gi/ hūm̐: rdo rje rgyal po= sogs/ mnga' gsol lo= stong thun rjes bzlos kyi/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang dam tshig gcig pa dang: sangs rgyas sa gsum dag la 'god bya'i phyir:

smin mtshams thal chen tshom bu'i mtshan mas gdab: tshig gsum 'dra ba la/ lkog mar zhag gi zo ris mtshan mas gdab: zhes dang*/ 'bur bzhir khrag gi thig le'i mtshan mas gdab: zhes brjod nas sgrub khog sngags kyis khrag zhag thal gsum byugs/ de nas las byang ltar brda sgo brda phyag dam tshig bsre bsnan ni/ bla mas las byang ltar/ bdud rtsi byin brlab/ sman mchod bsdus pa bya/ sman lhag oṃ badzra yakṣa kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: dam chu byin brlab/ sgrub khog gi rjes bzlos/ kyaiḥdam tshig chen po'i= sogs/ legs so= bar/ 'og tu/ hūm̐: rdo rje gsang ba'i= sogs/ sa ma ya hūm̐: bar dgongs 'dus mchod byin/ sgrub khog gi hūm̐: chos sku skye ba= sogs/ 371)bzhugs su gsol: bar/ sngar sta gon= sogs/ med par gyur: ye dhar/ sgrub khog gi byin 'bebs/ rig byin/ dur byin/ gzhal yas don bstod bcas bya'o/ ༈ dngos gzhi/ hriḥsngon= mchod byin/ spos phyung*/ skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun pa/ bkra rgya/ bdud rgyal/ pra khrid dang las byang sbrel/ lha bskyed skabs las byang gi dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zin bris/ nang 'dzin par byed= sogs/ 'od du zhu ba las= bar/ mdun bskyed nang*/ dpal chen po'i zhal yas= sogs/ mdun bskyed zhes pa'i mal du/ bdag mdun kha bsgyur/ dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ pra khrid nang*/ sras phur bskyed pa/ bdag nyid dpal= sogs/ gtams par bsgom/ bar/ las byang gi bdag mdun dbyer med mar me gcig las gnyis chad ltar bskyed mi dgos pas/ slar yang gsal btab pa ni/ hūm̐:chos sku skye ba= sogs/ pra mardha na ye hūm̐ phaṭaḥ pra khrid/ bdag dpal chen= sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum du gyur/ las byang*/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun= sogs/ spyan 'dren mtha' man pra khrid dang sbrags zhing*/ sbyor mchod mthar/ bstod pa zur 'gebs/ gsol 'debs/ 'dzab bskul/ pra khrid las/ bdag dang sras mchog gnyis kyi thugs kar= sogs/ yongs su gsal/ bar/ ki la ya 'bru bcu gsum thun bzung*/

gzhung bsrang gis dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ sgrub khog gi hūm̐: ye shes phur pa'i= sogs/ nyams chags bshags: tshig gnyis las sbyor dus bar bskyur/ dge bsngo/ sde bdun 'khrugs bsal/ phur gsol/ gang zhig= bar mdun bskyed tshogs byin rlabs nas 372) bskang rdzas/ rgyal ba'i spyi bskang*/ phud skong*/ 'dur byang drag po'am/ rgyal ba'i spyi bskang gang mos/ sde bskang*/ tshogs sgral zlog mthar/ sgrub khog gi bzlog thung*/ drang ba/ lhag ma/ chad brtan/ bro mnan yan bya'o/ mtshan thun ran dus/ gzhung chen bsnyen bstod gong ltar/ thun pa nas chags med bsgrigs ma ltar stong tshig mchod bstod spyi ltar/ dus drug nyul le bskrad pa spyi ltar/ ༈ nyin gnyis pa/ hrīḥsngon= nas/ skyabs sems bgegs gtor man sngar ltar/ bsnyen rgyun pas las byang btang*/ nyin gung byin 'bebs/ rig byin/ dur byin/ gnas byin bcas re mos btang*/ gzhung chen thun la 'jug gzhung bsrang thun gnyis pa pra khrid bsgrags thun gsum de ltar/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ bsnyen bsrang thun mong nas khro bcu bsnyen/ kī la rigs bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ bsnyen pa la 'jug gzhung bsrang mchod bstod/ bka' srung sogs sngar ltar ro/ ༈ nyin gsum bar bsnyen dmigs ki la ya bsnyen/ pra khrid las/ bdag dang sras mchog gnyis kyi thugs ka nas= sogs/ med par bsam/ ka taṃ ka ye= bsnyen/ thun bzung*/ gzhung bsrang thun dang po/ gsum pa las byang bstod pa/ gsol 'debs/ jab bskul/ pra khrid bsnyen dmigs gong la/ ki la ya bsnyen nas bsnyen bsrang gnyis nas/ khro bcu nas sngar ltar/ gzhung bsrang nas phur srung bcu drug bskul pa btang*/ bsnyen dmigs 'og ma/ ka taṃ ka ye= bsnyen/ de min snga ltar/ ༈ nyin drug pa las sbyor nyin/ ki la/ khro bcu sogs sngar ltar ka taṃ dmigs bzlas btang nas/ gsang sgrub zin 373) bris kyi/ sngags phreng kha dog= sogs las bzhi'i gsham can nyer gcig re/

lha rnams las sngags kyi 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad thul thul bsregs par bsam la/ spu gri bsnyen pa thun bzung*/ nyin gzhung byin 'bebs dmigs pa/ rig 'dzin byin 'bebs/ phyogs bzhi'i byin 'bebs/ sgrub khog gi byin 'bebs lan bzhi'i rjes su/ a zin ltar/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba= sogs/ du gsol: bar/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba= sogs/ rdzas la bstim/ bar/ badzra ki la 'i gsham can gang 'grub mthar sman mchod/ siddhi pha la sa rol/ gzhung bsrang gis thun gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i/ bstod pa/ gsol 'debs/ 'dzab bskul dmigs/ ki la bsnyen/ khro bcu sogs 'khor sngags/ bsnyen dmigs 'og ma/ ka taṃ= bsten nas/ dug mda' nag po cha tshang btang*/ spu gri'i dmigs bzlas/ gzhung chen bsrang*/ mchod bstod dge bsngo/ sde bdun 'khrugs bsal/ phur gsol/ pra khrid dang sprad pa'i tshogs bskang*/ bsgral bstab/ lhag chog chad bstan/ bro mnan yan rgyas pa bya/ ling khrus dang*/ dngos grub bskul chog ༈ nyin bdun pa'i mtshan thun gsum pa dang gzhung chen bsrang gnyis kas mnyam 'don/ gzhi bsnyen chig dril bar mtshan thun ltar/ sum bha= gha gha= khro bcu sogs kyi bgegs bskrad/ sgrub khog gi byin 'bebs/ rig byin/ sgrub khog gi rdo rje slob dpon= sogs/ ki la ya 'i sham du ka ya= sbyar/ hūm̐: lhag pa'i= sogs/ hūm̐:dgongs shig= sogs/ mnyam par shog: bar/ las byang gi dngos grub bskul mthar sman mchod/ gong gi sngags bsgrang ba'i tshe na bdag dbang blang ba yan kyis stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i rim pa grub/ 374) ༈ smad las dug phur nag po dang*/ byur sri mnan pa sbrags lugs ni/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ skyabs sems/ yan bdun/ bgegs gtor/ las byang bka' bsgo nas/ pyaṃ taṃ= bar/ spro na mdun bskyed/ phaṭaḥskad cig= sogs/ sgo bzhi'i mthar/ dril bu 'dzin= bar/ pra khrid ltar sras mchog bskyed/ mdun bskyed las/

khyams la phur srung= sogs/ bzhugs par gyur/ bar/ las byang gi badzra ki la= sogs/ spyan 'dren mthar mdun bskyed spyan 'dren sbyar/ bsdu na/ las byang gzhung rgyug la sras mchog bskyed/ mdun bskyed dor na chog de min gzhung ltar la/ 'dzab bskul yan bsnyen dmigs las sbyor dus ltar/ 'khor bsnyen yan zin nas/ dug phur las/ oṃ badzra ki li= thugs ka'i hūm̐ las= sogs/ so sor bstsal bar gyur/ zhes tshig mtha' kha bsgyur la/ gong gi sngags cung zad bzla/ dug phur 'og nas/ bdag nyid dpal chen po= sogs/ las byed par bsam/ bar/ spu gri bzla/ bsnyen rgyun gyi rjes 'brang gzhung chen bsrang gnyis kas/ thun rdzas byin brlabs/ mchod bstod/ tshogs bskang bshags/ 'jug bde bas phur bsrung gsol bsdus/ gtor bzlog la dmigs te/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ ru tra'i keṃ rus mtshon cha'i phung po rnam par 'bar ba khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dkyil nas skyes pa las me rab tu 'bar bas dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par bsam/ bzlog sngags spu gri cung zad bzla/ bzlog thung bcas/ dug mda' nag po rdzogs par btang / 375) dug phur/ kyai/ bdag ni= sogs/ mdzad du gsol/ bar mdun bskyed las/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sogs/ phaṭaḥ bar/ gong du/ oṃ badzra raksha= sogs/ yod par gyur/ bar/ na mo/ rig 'dzin= sogs/ lan gsum/ bden chung*/ rtsa rgyud/ bdag gi thugs ka= sogs/ hoḥ bar/ sri mnan mtha'/ rang bzhin rdo rje gzhon nu= sogs/ bstim: bar/ 'gugs gzhug mtshams su/ gzugs can= spu gri'i gsham du/ oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭaṃ= sogs/ nan= spro na dug phur las/ bdag dpal chen po'i= sogs/ dngos su bstim/ bar/ spu gri'i sngags/ dgra bgegs dam sri byur sri phung sri'i bla khug aṅku sha dzaḥ sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ badzra kī li ki la yaḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shi ghraṃ a na a hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces dang*/ oṃ badzra kī li ki la ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs byad ma hri yaṃ dzaḥ

tri yaṃ dzaḥ zhes rigs 'gres te/ khro bcu nas gzhi snying bar 'gres su sbyar/ bsnyen rgyun rjes 'brang*/ dug phur las/ bdag mdun dkyil 'khor= sogs/ 'dug par bsgoms: mdun bskyed las/ hūm̐: dam tshigs chen po'i= sogs/ bral par gyis: sngags lan gsum/ smon lam/ bral bar gyur cig: spu gri sngags/ byur sri dam sri= sogs/ stam bha ya nanaḥ bar/ dril thun/ spu gri/ badzra sarba duṣṭan sogs/ ma ra ya rbad nan: bar dang*/ hūm̐ bhyo: dam sri bya ba'i= nan nan: de'i snga dro'i thun grub/ ༈ 'di nas gzhung chen 376) gyis thun gnyis pa dang mnyam du/ gzhung bsrang gis las byang brda sgo dbye ba nas bsnyen bstod mthar phur srung gsol bsdus gtong ba bcas 'gro dgos/ ༈ gzhung chen gyis/ thun gnyis pa ni/ dug mda' le'u lnga pa bar dang*/ bstod pa zur 'debs bskul pa bcas gang mos/ gzu dpang tshigs bcad/ bden bdar/ hom bskyed/ 'gugs pa sogs dang*/ lha dbye tshigs bcad zin bar sngar ltar spro na ming gzhug dang*/ gzhung sngags grangs bzung*/ bsnyen rgyun rjes 'brang*/ mthar smon lam/ byur sri dril thun sogs gong ltar ra ram bzlog thung lan gsum/ ༈ gzhung chen bsrang gis/ drang ba lhag ma chad brtan bro mnan yan zin nas/ thun gsum pa/ dug mda' le'u dang po/ gzhan sngar ltar/ lha dbye/ smon lam yan zin nas/ dug phur las/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi= sogs/ bstim bsam/ mdun bskyed las/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i= sogs/ gzir bar gyis: bar/ spro na spu gri'i mthar gsham sbyar ba dang*/ gzhung ltar bsnyen grangs bzung*/ bsnyen rgyun rjes 'brang*/ gzhung chen gyi mthar smon lam/ byur sri dril thun gong ltar/ thun gsum pa'i tshe gzhung bsrang gis/ las byang 'dzab bstod/ phur gsol rgyas pa btang dgos/ mtshan thun rnams kyis dug phur las/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi= sogs/ bstim par bsam bar/ 377) mdun bskyed las/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i=

sogs/ gzir bar gyis: bar/ spu gri'i ming gzhug bsdus pa dang*/ gzhung sngags grangs bzung*/ mthar dril thun gyis 'jog ༈ gzhung bsrang gis mtshan thun gsum gtong lugs/ las byang*/ phur srung gsol ka smad las bcas nyin thun ltar dgos kyang*/ 'jug bde'i dbang du btang na/ gsang sgrub rgyun khyer bsdus pa'i/ spyi gtsug= sogs/ 'grub par mdzod: bar dang*/ las byang gi/ hūm̐:thugs dam chen po'i= sogs/ rdo rjer bsgom: bar/ bsnyen pa/ ki la ya= nyer gcig ka taṃ ka ye= nyer gcig spu gri'i sngags dgu 'don nas phur gsol bsdus pa btang*/ bskul pa dug mda' le'u dang po/ bltas chog las/

oṃ badzra raksha= sogs/ 'gugs pa gcig ho ho hoḥ bar/ sri mnan las/ rang nyid rdo rje= sogs/ phur 'gugs mtshams su/ gzugs can= sbyar ba tshar gcig byur sri sngags 'og ma tshar gcig spu gri'i bla 'gugs sbyar ba tshar gcig bltas chog las/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i= sogs/ sngags gzhung ltar tshar gsum re/ mthar smon lam/ gzhung sngags tshar gsum/ phob cig= bar/ byur sri dril thun nyin mo'i skabs ltar bya ba yin no/ ༈ nyin brgyad par hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ skyabs sems/ maṇḍal/ bgegs gtor nas sngar nyin ltar la/ gzugs dbab mtha'i smon lam bar/ thun dang po song rjes/ dug phur las/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi= sogs/ bcings bar bsam bar/ 378) mdun bskyed las/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i= sogs/ mthar spu gri'i gsham can gzhung ltar/ byur sri dril thun bcas kyi snga dro song*/ ༈ thun gnyis pa la/ byad gzhug yan gong ltar la/ dug phur dmigs pa/ mdun bskyed bskul pa sngags bcas kyis smyor gzhug man la byur sri dril thun/ bzlog pa tshar ci 'gro/ khyung*/ bzlog thung*/ drang lhag chad brtan/ bro mnan yan bya/ ༈ thun gsum pa smyor gzhug yan zin nas/ dug phur mtha' nas ting nge 'dzin ni/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha yang sprul dang bcas pa dang*/ lha bdud rnam rol 'khor dang bcas pas rdo rje ri rab gyi tho ba thogs nas sgrub bya rdul du brlag par bsam/ mdun bskyed 'jug nas/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i= sogs/ bzhin du brlog: bar dang*/ spro na/ dug phur 'don 'grigs las/ gru gsum nang du= sogs/ brlag par bsam bar/ karma raṃ raṃ= can gyi spu gri ci 'grub dang*/ gzhung gi sngags/ oṃ badzra ki li ki la ya dgra bgegs ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ thum ril ta tha ya ta tha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra ki li ki la ya dgra bgegs gnod byed ta tha ya ta tha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ grangs bzung*/ mthar smon lam/ byur sri dang po dril mthun/ byur sri bar ma 'don nas dug phur tshan pa'i

shin tu= mtha' nas/ 379)dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dam can srung ma dang bcas pa'i zhal du re ma ris bstob grogs byas nas= sogs/ rol bar bsam bar/ mdun bskyed brdung shig= mtha' nas/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i= sogs/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du bstab: bar/ oṃ badzra ki li ki la ya: dgra bgegs gnod byed bhindha ya bhindha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum bsnyen/ mthar smon lam/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa dang bcas pa lhag ma med par rol cig bar btang*/ dam sri bya ba'i las ngan= sogs/ bya bar mtshan thun pas rdul brlag dmigs bskul/ sngags/ smon lam/ dril thun/ zhal bstab/ bzlog thung bcas bya/ ༈ gzhung bsrang rdul brlag byur sri dang po/ dril thun bar ma/ zhal bstab bar ma las gzhan 'dra/ dam sri bya ba'i= sogs/ lhag ma med par gsol cig bar/ ༈ nyin dgu par mtshan thun gsum pa'i dus tsam la/ gzhung chen bsrang pa kun gyi/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ skyabs sems/ yan bdun/ bgegs gtor/ las byang bka' bsgo nas gzhung rgyug sras phur bskyed/ bstod pa bsdu na chog 'dzab bskul zin nas/ sngags gsum ci nus/ mchod bstod las byang ltar/ tshogs dang mdun bskyed ltar bskang ba/ phur srung gsol ka rgyas bsdus gang rung bcas zin nas/ spro na rig 'dzin bskul pa/ 380) bskul pa dug mda' tshang bar brjod/ dug phur nang*/ hūm̐: bdag ni tshig= sogs/ tshigs bcad/ mdun bskyed/ oṃ badzra raksha= sogs/ 'gugs pa lan gsum/ bden/ rtsa/ byur sri 'gugs pa/ sngags 'og ma tshar nas las byang gi hūm̐: khyed kyi dam tshig= sogs/ smyo ru chug= bar/ sngags rnams bdun re/ oṃ badzra ki li= bdag nyid dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor gyis tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing nag shin tu 'jigs la rngams par gyur/ dug phur las/ lag pa g.yas= sogs/ las byang dbang bskur sogs de nang ltar la mgo kha bsgyur dgos/ pyaṃ taṃ= bar/ 'og tu las byang las/

hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i= sogs/ myong bar mdzod: bar spro na dug phur las/ phur srung= sogs/ sngags bzla/ med par bsam bar/ gong du dug phur las/ bdag rtsa ba phyogs bcu khro bo= sogs/ sems su gyur/ oṃ laṃ= sogs/ tshar gcig yang dkyil 'khor= sogs/ kun gzhi'i ngo bo āḥ gnas par gyur/ oṃ laṃ= sogs tshar gcig las byang las/ dam tshig chen po'i= sogs/ myong bar mdzod: bar tshar gcig dug phur las/ kho yi snying nang na= sogs/ ldan par gyur/ bar/ sri mnan/ byur sri dam sri= sogs/ mdun bskyed nang*/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings= sogs/ brlag par mdzod: dug phur las/ liṅga dgra bo= sogs/ song bar bsam/ bar/ spro na dug phur las/ bsad sngags gong 'og gnyis ci nus bzla/ ( khong khra'i ?) las gsum ni 381) las byang las/ spu gri'i mthar 'khor bcu'i sngags sogs/ ta tha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ las byang ngam/ mdun bskyed bsgral ba'i mthar/ sgo bzhi/ hūm̐: phyag gnyen chen mo'i dus= sogs/ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ yang ( khong khra ?) ni/ las byang gi spu gri'i mthar/ oṃ badzra kro dha= sogs/ ta tha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de mtshams/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de bzhin du/ ratna/ padma/ karma/ bzhi dang*/ spu gri'i sngags dang*/ gzhi snying chig dril mthar/ dgra bgegs ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ yang ( khong khra ?) rgyas pa/ spu gri/ khro bcu/ sogs nas/ ta tha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ spu gri/ byur sri nang*/ oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭan= sogs/ las byang ngam mdun bskyed gang rung gi hūm̐: brdung shig rdo rje= sogs/ las byang gi zhal bstab/ hūm̐: bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub= sogs/ skye mched bcu gnyis la kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ bar/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dam sri bya ba'i= sogs/ des dgra las dngos grub blang ba grub/ 'dir lha las dngos grub len chog stod las ltar dgos kyang lag len zor yang ched gong du 'then pas 'thus/ de 'phral drag po'i sbyin sreg phur gzhung ngam/ gnam chos drag sbyin rgyas pa bya/

gtor bzlog tshar gcig bzlog sngags nyer gcig btang*/ tshogs la rol/ lhag chog btang zin nas/ bzlog pas khro rgyal stobs 'dus dang*/ dbal mdos bzlog pa/ rtsang bzlog 382) bcas tshar grangs ci 'grub btang nas/ sgo dbye ni/ khyung mtha'i/ hūm̐: shar gyi= sogs/ phaṭaḥ lha la mchod bstod/ yig brgyas nongs bshags/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma ti: oṃ badzro tiṣṭha: ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs par dmigs/ gtor ma nad dug mtshon gyi rang bzhin du bsam la/ gtso 'khor thams cad gyi sngags spel tshig can dang*/ spu gri'i sngags bzlas pas zor rdzas nus pa bskyed/ gtor rdzongs btab/ gtor snod bhandha= sogs/ rtsa rgyud/ bstod pa zur 'gebs/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ sbyar/ mtha' bar/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ dug mda' tshar gcig de nas rgyal tho 'di'i mtshams bsdu na/ sgrub chen spyi'i bca' tho bkra shis tshe brten gyis mdzad pa'am/ yang na/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'bru gsum/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin du: sgrub pa srung mdzad sku drin du: gtang rag mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes: rtsa sngags la gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum/ arghaṃ= sogs mchod/ a zin las/ hūm̐: dri za'i rgyal po= sogs/ tshig bzhi pa kha bsgyur ba/ shar phyogs srung mtshams mdzad la bstod: sgrub khog gi kyai hoḥ mgon po= mdzad du gsol: bar/ de bzhin du kha bsgyur ba dang lag len 'gres/ sgo byang la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'bru gsum/ sngags 'bul a zin ltar/ hūm̐: bgegs kyi bdag po gshin rje 383)gshed: ngo mtshar rmad byung sgrub pa yi: phyi rol sgo yi srung ma mdzad: khyed kyi thugs dam ngo mtshar che: gtang rag mchod bzhes dbyings su gshegs: badzra muḥ de bzhin sngags bsgyur/ hūm̐: khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil: dang*/ phyi rol mal du/ phyi nang sgo yi= zhes kha bsgyur bas 'thus/

khro bcu bsdu ba/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa na sarba artha sā dha ni swā hāḥ ces phur rtse 'o mas bkru nas blang*/ ༈ phyi sgo gser skyems spyi btang ltar/ chad tho btang nas/ zor rgyas pa zur gsal ltar/ mnan pa ma hā bha la= sbrags pa zur gsal bzhin bya ba'am/ 'jug bder byas na/ hūm̐:bdag ni ma nyes= sogs/ dug phur ltar/ do nub mnan pa'i las mdzod cig: kha bsgyur/ steng na gnas pa'i lha tshogs kun/ = = snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyang*/ = = las mdzod cig bar btang*/ e khang bskyed pa/ dgugs gzhug bden chung*/ rtsa rgyud/ byur 'gugs/ byur sngags 'og ma/ gong ma/ bar ma gsum/ babs brgyad bskul pa ni/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i= sogs/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: zung shig rgyob cig rnam par chings: mnan no non cig sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ sgrub khog ltar na/ hūm̐: gcig ni= sogs/ las bzhi'i bro rdzogs par bya/ tshur log nas rgyal rtags gso ba'i dmigs pa rnams dang ldan pas ki la ya bsnyen/ mchod bstod rgyas pa bya/ a zin nas/ bum pa bhrūm̐ las= sogs/ sngags brgya rtsa/ sgrub khog gi 384) hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po= sogs/ g.yu tshe bhrūm̐: dbang bskur/ gter sbas ni/ sgrub khog gi gong du/ chos dbyings bden= sogs/ rdo rje'i sar phyin shog: bkra shis shog: brjod/ a li ka li/ yig brgya/ rten snying lan gsum bzla/ ras bris la/ mdun bskyed kyi= sogs/ rten bzhugs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dam tshig rnams rang la bsdu/ bdag skyed bsdu ldang ni/ sgrub khog las/ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas= sogs/ dbyings su dgar bsgom/ bar/ 'og tu/ chos nyid stong= sogs/ sngags nyer gcig bzla/ a zin las/ bdag skad cig gi= sogs/ spyod lam bya'o/ 'og tu/ rang nyid me dpung= sogs/ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐: bar/ sgrub khog gi mtha' rgyas las/ hūm̐: thams cad sgrub pa'i=

sogs/ mar me'i smon lam 'gor/ stong thun rjes bzlos bcas zin nas/ bsngo ba mthun gyur bcas rgyas spros sam/ yang na gnam chos ltar bya/ rol mo dang bcas pas bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho rgyas par brjod cing zhi rol sbir bas phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tuu dge legs kyi snang ba chen pos khyab par bya'o// de ltar chos rgyal ratna gling pa'i zab gter phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi grub chen smad las dang sbrel ba'i sgrigs chog dang*/ las 'grigs shin tu mang yang*/ gzhung gi dgongs pa'i gnad longs pa can dka' bas 'di ni 'jam mgon bla ma blo gros mtha' yas kyi yig cha ltar/ gzhung gi dgongs pa lon pa gzhir bzhag grub brnyes rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab kyi phyag bzhes kyis kha bskang ba/ dbang rnon chos kyis rjes 'brang rnams kyi yid ston pher nges pa yod pas shin tu gces spras su bya'o/ zhes pa'ang dpal yul ba'i gdan rabs gsum pa grub dbang padma 385) nor bu'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs thob pa/ mang du thos pa'i gzugs brnyan/ shākya'i dge slong 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros kyis smras pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba dā ka lya naṃ bha wantu/ dge'o// 386)
